name_en: Namazu no Tempura — deep-fried catfish from Itakura's waterways
summary_ja: 利根川や渡良瀬川に囲まれた「群馬の水郷」板倉町の名物。皮ごと揚げたなまずはふっくらとした白身でクセが少なく、川魚問屋やその料理店が軒を連ねた町の食文化を今に伝えている。
summary_en: A specialty of Itakura, a town ringed by the Tone and Watarase rivers and known as Gunma's water country. Catfish is fried skin-on into a mild, fluffy-fleshed dish that carries on the river-fish trade the town once ran.
source_title: なまずの天ぷら｜うちの郷土料理｜農林水産省
